snippet.title: The Forgotten Nightmare Series - game play
snippet.description:
A quick look at The Forgotten Nightmare Series — my all-text adventure, reborn for modern devices. Type a command, explore, and let the auto-drawing map chart your way.

Hi, I'm Chris. 
This is a short teaser for a game I just finished: The Forgotten Nightmare Series, an all-text adventure spanning three chapters. No graphics, no soundtrack — just you, your imagination, and a world that needs figuring out. You type classic verb/noun commands (take key, open door) to explore and solve puzzles, the way text adventures worked back on the Commodore VIC-20 that got me hooked in the first place. The difference is I built it to run on modern hardware, with an auto-drawing map and a hint system to keep you moving.

It's a post-apocalyptic, faith-themed story about waking up with no memory in a world gone quiet — and slowly piecing together who you are and what happened.

There's much more I want to show, but I wanted to share the feel of it first.

▶ Out now on Steam, Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Android, and itch.io.

🛒 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4362760/The_Forgotten_Nightmare_Series
🎮 itch.io: https://chrisradford.itch.io/the-forgotten-nightmare-series
🌐 https://www.theforgottennightmare.com

If you'd like to follow along, a wishlist or follow genuinely helps a solo dev out.
